shared_instances_caveat: all solvers ran the same seed stream, so their estimates are correlated and sign agreement is not independent evidence
conclusion: 0 of 3 solvers show a difference whose interval excludes zero, so the negative control is NOT violated by this data: weak and hardened are publicly indistinguishable within the resolution available. All three point estimates put weak slightly harder (+0.0676, +0.0420, +0.0464), but they share instances, so that agreement is close to one observation rather than three, and every interval spans zero. The direction worth watching is the opposite one: weak EASIER publicly would mean the solver is feeding on the weakness that gives the private route its shortcut, and that is the failure that would sink the construction. Nothing here shows it. Settling the residual tilt needs an independent seed stream, not more solvers on these instances.
